one_line: Anthropic buys $3.4 billion in gas generators, Nvidia's board investigates CEO Jensen Huang, and AI super PACs see mixed midterm results.

themes.title: AI labs and datacenters secure massive power
themes.text: Anthropic purchased $3.4 billion in commitments for 1.7GW of gas-fired generators, marking the largest known generator purchase by an AI lab. Meanwhile, Envision Group opened its gigawatt-scale Galaxy AI datacenter in Inner Mongolia, targeting 3 GW by late 2028.

stories.headline: Anthropic buys 1.7GW of gas-fired generators in $3.4B deal
Envision Group opens gigawatt-scale Galaxy AI datacenter in Inner Mongolia

themes.title: Nvidia board investigates CEO Jensen Huang
themes.text: Nvidia's board launched an independent investigation after CEO Jensen Huang admitted to an affair with a suspected Chinese spy. The board stated it has no evidence that company secrets or national security were compromised.

stories.headline: Nvidia board launches investigation after CEO Jensen Huang admits affair
Nvidia board launches probe into CEO Jensen Huang over alleged spy plot

themes.title: AI super PACs and data centers face midterm shifts
themes.text: The Anthropic-backed super PAC Public First spent over $63 million in the midterms with 10 of 17 candidates winning, while the pro-AI network Leading the Future fell short after most of its backed candidates lost. Post-midterm results also brought voter rejection of data centers and anti-data center politicians following Democratic victories.

stories.headline: After the midterms, things are looking rocky for Elon Musk and data centers
Anthropic-backed PAC Public First spent $63M+ in 2026 midterms
Pro-AI super PAC network Leading the Future falls short in midterms
